title: FT cuts OpenAI revenue estimate; AI stocks sell off
summary: An FT report cut OpenAI's estimated annualized revenue from about $70B to $50B, setting off an AI-stock selloff with Oracle down about 5% to around $136. Dao weighed shorting Oracle (dot-com ~80% decline comparison); CoreWeave and Nvidia seen as losers vs Google and Apple.
connection_notes: Start of AI-bubble/short thesis; OpenAI dependence links ORCL, CRWV, NVDA.

title: FAA approves Boeing 737 MAX 10
summary: Boeing's 737 MAX 10 got FAA approval; the stock slipped 0.5% to close near $191 as the news was seen as priced in.

title: Oct 21 close: Nasdaq +1.05%
summary: Nasdaq rose 1.05%; Nvidia closed at $221.97, SpaceX (SPCX) jumped 7.8%, and CoreWeave closed at $61.82 amid bond stress.
connection_notes: Rally before the Oct 22 chip rout.

title: Big Pharma oncology sales ranking (2025)
summary: 2025 oncology sales: Merck ~$35.4B, Roche ~$29B, AstraZeneca $25.6B, J&J $25.4B, BMS ~$25-26.6B. Threats include ADCs (Daiichi Sankyo), Chinese bispecifics, and Keytruda's 2028 patent expiry.
connection_notes: Keytruda 2028 cliff drives Merck's vaccine combo and Roche/AZN competition.

title: Futures fall on Saudi strikes; Brent ~$112
summary: Futures fell (Nasdaq -1.8%, S&P -1.1%, Dow -0.7%) after strikes in Saudi Arabia hit Dammam airport, pushing Brent up 3% to ~$112; KMI, COP, VLO rose 1-2%.

title: 20-yr auction yield highest since 1986; France 10y >5%
summary: The 20-year Treasury auction cleared at the highest yield since 1986 and France's 10-year topped 5% for the first time since 2002. Yields then fell, with the 10-year down 17bp to ~4.96% at the Oct 22 close.
connection_notes: Rates pressure on CRWV/ORCL debt; yield drop lifted homebuilder LEN +7.7%. Auction reported Oct 22.

title: Nikkei -2.65%; China index enters bear market
summary: Japan's Nikkei fell 2.65% and China's main index entered a bear market, down 20% from its June high.

title: MU + NVDA ~36% of S&P Q3 earnings growth
summary: Micron and Nvidia account for about 36% of S&P 500 Q3 earnings growth; excluding the top 10, earnings fell 11%.

title: Meta hit with $25B New Mexico penalty
summary: Meta was hit with a $25B New Mexico penalty tied to Cambridge Analytica and plans to appeal.

title: AVEX denies Navy drone-boat halt report
summary: Reports said the Navy stopped buying AVEX drone boats; the company denied it and shares rose 11% premarket.

title: Risky data center debt market frozen until after midterms
summary: The market for risky data center debt is frozen until after the midterms, hitting CRWV, NBIS and IREN.
connection_notes: Causal: capex boom -> neocloud debt -> rates/midterms.

title: Meta Q3: FCF negative, stock -7%
summary: Meta's Q3 revenue was $64.6B with capex of $34.9B, and FCF went negative for the first time in a decade (-$2.1B). Op margin was 20%, 2026 capex is guided to $135-145B, and it plans non-voting shares. The stock fell 7% to ~$649, with ~$825B in future commitments.
connection_notes: Capex -> NVDA demand -> neocloud debt chain. First reported Oct 21/22 (-2% premarket).

title: Tesla Q3 beat; capex trimmed
summary: Tesla posted EPS of $0.48 vs $0.43 expected and FCF of $1.53B, with capex ~$20B (down from >$25B) and Cybercab in Austin. The stock fell 3.1%.

title: CoreWeave slides; bonds yield ~15%
summary: CoreWeave fell 10% to ~$55.60 (low $53.50) and is down 29% in October, worth ~$34B vs ~$90B at its peak. Bonds yield ~15% and CDS ~10.7%; Goldman rates it Buy.

title: Oracle near junk with ~$169B debt
summary: Oracle closed at $129.13 (-1.5%) on Oct 21, carries ~$288B in off-balance-sheet leases and ~$169B of debt, and is rated just above junk.
connection_notes: Short thesis candidate. Close reported Oct 22.

title: OpenAI models on Google Cloud
summary: OpenAI models became available on Google Cloud.

title: Lam Research record revenue, stock -11.8%
summary: Lam posted record revenue of $8.22B (+54%) but gave a wide guide; shares fell 11.8%.

title: TI revenue +28%, data center nearly doubles
summary: Texas Instruments revenue rose 28%, data center nearly doubled, and its guide beat.

title: IBM beats, reverses lower
summary: IBM beat estimates and rose ~10% after hours, then fell 5%.

summary: Nvidia struck a $3B packaging deal with Amkor.

summary: Gilead's oral ulcerative colitis pill hit 66% vs 37% for placebo in Phase 2.

connection_notes: Defense demand tied to Iran tensions. First reported Oct 22.

title: Nasdaq -2.6%, chip index -6.7%
summary: On Oct 22 the Nasdaq fell 2.6% (worst since June), the S&P 500 fell 1.2% to 7,663 and the chip index dropped 6.7%, while the Dow ended +0.02%. Staples rose 3.3% and tech fell 3.3%; AMD lost 8.1% and GOOGL 3.2%. The VIX jumped 14% to 19 and hedge fund shorts hit a ~5-year high.

title: Nvidia -4.4%; Huang flags 'scarcity of capital'
summary: Nvidia fell 4.4% as Jensen Huang cited a 'scarcity of capital'.

title: AI power names sell off: GEV -10.6%, VST, BE
summary: GE Vernova fell 10.6% and Vistra more than 10%. Bloom Energy dropped 9% despite record revenue of $1.24B (+138%) and a 2026 guide of $4.4-4.6B.

title: Chip/optical rout: TER, ALAB, MU, COHR, LITE
summary: TER fell 10.6%, ALAB 11%, MU 6.3%, COHR 13% and LITE 11.7%. WDC fell despite revenue of $4.38B (+55%), EPS of $4.64 and a $5.0-5.2B guide.

summary: Nvidia reports around Nov 17.
